notes.title: Voltage High Society - The Gangland Update now live
notes.notes:
[i]Enter. Evolve. Escape.[/i]

[previewyoutube=viVfhal6Sjo;full][/previewyoutube]

In this cyberpunk-bodyhorror-metroidvania, you are a nameless prisoner thrown into an island ruled by cybernetic monsters. Fight your way through the horrors, gain new weapons and abilities, and look for an way out. Inspired by japanese cyberpunk and Escape from New York, featuring gritty retro graphics with modern touches.

[b]Buy now[/b]: https://store.steampowered.com/app/2063480/Voltage_High_Society/

notes.title: New update with fixed game start language out soon!
notes.notes:
We are currently working with an update which will fix some minor grammar and other details in new supported languages. We will also crush the bug that makes the game start with Russian language by default for some players. 

If the game starts in Russian and you want to change the language, just click the third option counting from the top on main menu. And then click the last option on the bottom. That should change the language. 

Thank you for your patience!

notes.title: Important information regarding the 1.03 update
notes.notes: The newest update of Lydia will destroy old save game files. We implemented a new save system on the 1.02 update, but the save data isn’t stored when you update the game. We’re very, very sorry about this and are working on a fix in the next update.

notes.title: 1.03 Patch is now live
notes.notes:
1.03 Patch notes

- Fixed several grammar issues & typos. The texts are now proof-read
- Fixed a few minor graphic issues
- Fixed issues regarding triggers
- Fixed a few issues regarding hotspots
- Minor tweaks for particle effects
- Minor tweaks in NavMeshes in the third chapter
- Made groundwork for upcoming translations, available in the next update

And Linux version is just around the corner! Alongside with translations.

notes.title: Lydia - Steam Update v1.02
notes.notes:
Lydia - Steam Update v1.02 Patch Notes

-    Implemented a new save system. Progress is saved automatically in start of each scene. Previously saved games are discarded
-    Implemented new options menu. Resolution and full screen selections are now moved to options menu. The Unity start dialog is now disabled
-    Added a speech volume slider in options menu
-    Implemented a tutorial for Quick Time Event, that takes place on the first chapter of the game
-    Updated main menu
-    Added splash screens to menu (New game overwrite warning, quit game warning & information about autosave when player clicks the new game button)
-    Fixed layer bugs in various scenes
-    Fixed minor audio issues throughout the game
-    Fixed minor graphical issues throughout the game

notes.title: Issues with the new update
notes.notes:
We're having technical difficulties with the latest update (version 1.01). So if possible, please don't update the game just yet, the newest update will make the game unplayable.

We're very sorry for this and are working as fast as possible to fix it. We'll post an update as soon as everything working again.
